advancement.grandsigil.the_gaze.title: The Gaze
advancement.grandsigil.the_gaze.descript: Open something in the sky that is on nobody's side.
advancement.grandsigil.no_ones_side.desc: Hold a dozen things still at once, and watch none of them do anything about it.
spell.grandsigil.grand_sigil.guide: Inscribe a ritual circle on the ground under one creature. It is bound inside it and cannot take a step. A second circle then stacks above the first for every rune the incantation reaches -- twelve of them over seven seconds, each a semitone above the last, until a tower ninety blocks tall stands over the thing that cannot move. Then the whole tower falls in on itself, gathers into a single point above it, and goes off. The largest single number in Apex Arcana, on exactly one target. Kill the caster, or kill the target before the twelfth circle, and it collapses without firing.
spell.grandsigil.sunfall.guide: Take hold of the sun. It walks across the sky to noon, gathers, and fires straight down through everything beneath it. Works at midnight -- it does not need the sun to be up, it brings it up.
spell.grandsigil.skybreak.guide: Crack the sky open and strike once through the gap. One bolt, and branches off it reaching every hostile thing in range at the same moment. A roof is the only answer, and the thunder arrives late.
spell.grandsigil.world_tree.guide: Grow a tree through the battlefield. Its roots hold what they catch and its canopy mends what shelters under it -- and everything that dies beneath it feeds it, so it grows a stage taller and reaches a little further, six times over.
spell.grandsigil.heaven_gate.guide: Open a gate a hundred and twenty blocks up and let a corridor of light down out of it, wide enough to stand a party in. Inside, allies are mended and enemies burn; the undead are simply not allowed to be there.
spell.grandsigil.glaciation.guide: Take hold of a mountain of ice and hang it a hundred and seventy blocks over a place. It waits there for three seconds with its shadow on the ground -- long enough for anybody who looks up to walk out from under it -- and then it comes down. Whatever is still underneath is entombed, and cannot be hurt: but every blow landed on the ice is kept, and paid back with interest when the mountain slumps.
spell.grandsigil.the_gaze.guide: Open an eye a hundred and twenty blocks across in the sky. Everything hostile beneath it is transfixed: a ring of eyes opens in the air around each of them and watches, and for as long as they are watched they cannot take a step and cannot cast a spell. They can still look around, which is the only thing they get. It deals no damage whatsoever -- it is the one spell here that cannot kill anything, and the one worth casting when you cannot win the damage race. Fourteen seconds of a room that is not in the fight, handed to whoever is standing next to you. Watch it yourself for three seconds and it notices you.
ui.grandsigil.glaciation.freezes: Crushes the ground it lands on, and freezes it over

ui.grandsigil.voidgrip.splash: And %s to whatever they land on
ui.grandsigil.voidgrip.window: The grip takes whoever is still there when it closes
advancement.grandsigil.voidgrip.title: Grip of the Void
advancement.grandsigil.voidgrip.descript: Take something off its feet, and give it back.
advancement.grandsigil.off_your_feet.des: Hold a whole room in the air at once.
spell.grandsigil.voidgrip.guide: Tear islands of the End into the sky and take hold of everything under them. They come off the ground, rise thirty blocks, and hang there unable to do anything at all for three seconds -- and then the grip drives them straight back into the floor hard enough to hurt whatever they land on. Three quarters of a second to walk out is all the warning there is.

ui.grandsigil.colosseum.feeds: Half of that heals you; every death makes the walls take faster
ui.grandsigil.colosseum.collapse: And it falls in for %s, plus everything it drank
advancement.grandsigil.colosseum.title: The Colosseum
advancement.grandsigil.full_house.title: Full House
advancement.grandsigil.full_house.descri: Kill enough inside it to fill the rim with arms.
spell.grandsigil.colosseum.guide: Spend a fifth of your health to raise a wall of bone forty-five blocks high around the field -- three tiers of arches, a solid red barrier behind them, and blood running down the whole inside. Nobody inside gets out, and it rains lances on them for fourteen seconds. Everything in there bleeds, half of it heals you, and every death makes the walls take faster. Then it falls in on whatever is left.
ui.grandsigil.colosseum.thirst: Bleeds harder for every death inside it
ui.grandsigil.colosseum.rain: Rains barbed lances inside the walls for %s

ui.grandsigil.field.clash: Domain strength %s. The stronger of two overlapping domains eats the weaker
spell.grandsigil.caldera.guide: Turn thirty blocks of ground into a volcano for a minute. The floor becomes basalt shot through with veins of magma, and you and everything on your side are given fire resistance -- so the terrain is a floor to you and a slow burn to everybody else. That is the whole spell: the buff and the debuff are one piece of ground read from two sides. You have to stand in it. Where two domains overlap, the one with the higher spell power consumes the other; if they are equal, both casters keep their footing and neither can touch the other. Nothing is destroyed -- every block is written down and put back when the minute is up.

ui.grandsigil.reckoning.burn: And %s a second for as long as it stands

advancement.grandsigil.nothing_left.desc: Catch eight things in one pillar, in the frame it arrives.
spell.grandsigil.reckoning.guide: Spend five seconds making a star small enough to hold. It starts as a mote between your hands and does not stop: gold hoops close in on it, turn around it, and are swallowed by a flood of light you cannot look at directly. Then throw it. Where it lands, a column of light stands on the world -- everything hostile inside is struck once and hard the moment it arrives, and the light is still there for seven seconds afterwards, burning whatever is still standing in it. Undead take two and a half times either. Allies caught in it are given the light instead: regeneration while it stands, and absorption to carry out of it. Break the incantation and the star goes out in your hands.
ui.grandsigil.one_domain: This book already holds %s. One Apex Arcana domain to a book.

advancement.grandsigil.black_coffin.desc: Close a box on somebody, and let the lances do the rest.
advancement.grandsigil.closed_casket.des: Seal five things into one box.
spell.grandsigil.black_coffin.guide: Speak for four and a half seconds and a field of gravity closes on a piece of ground and takes the shape of a box. Everything sealed inside is pinned where it stands by the weight of it, and anything nearby is dragged toward the walls. Then the lances come: twenty-four of them, driving in through the walls from every side over four seconds, one after another, until the box is a pincushion -- and then it comes apart on whatever is left. It is the only spell here that kills slowly enough to watch, and that is also its weakness: kill the caster while the box is standing and every lance that has not landed yet never does.

advancement.grandsigil.not_one_missed.de: Land every blade the armoury draws.
spell.grandsigil.thousand_blades.guide: A wall of sixty-four golden gates opens in the air behind you and the armoury empties itself: a hundred and twenty giant blades over eight seconds, slow at first and then a storm. Each one is drawn out of its gate point first, accelerates, and bends in a long arc toward somebody -- the blades are shared between the sixteen nearest hostile things. Near the end a great gate opens high over the thickest of the crowd, and the king's sword, thirty blocks long, slides out of it and comes down the diagonal into the ground among them. Blades that find their mark stay in the wound; the rest stand in the ground, and all of them turn back into light a few seconds later.

spell.grandsigil.phoenix.guide: A bird of fire forms in a pillar of flame where you stand and climbs into the sky. It flies two laps over the point you aimed at -- the first wide, the second tight -- and the fire falling from it catches on the ground, so that by the end the target is standing inside two burning rings. Then it pulls up, hangs for a moment at the top of the climb, folds its wings and dives straight into the middle. What rises out of the explosion is the same bird, spreading its wings once more before it comes apart into embers.

Bring down eight or more with a single thunder dragon.
spell.grandsigil.thunder_dragon.guide: A storm a hundred and thirty blocks across gathers ahead of you, and out of its eye comes a dragon of lightning a hundred and fifty blocks long. It swims round under the storm in a vast heaving ring, and every few seconds it turns its head and spits lightning at something below: twelve strikes, monsters first, each one wider and harder than the last. Then it folds out of the ring and dives head first onto the thickest of the crowd, and the whole length of it pours down into that one point after its head, every coil bursting as it arrives -- until the tail goes in and the storm lets go of everything it has left.

advancement.grandsigil.full_bloom.descri: Raise a flower of light over the battlefield.
advancement.grandsigil.in_full_flower.de: Wilt ten or more under a single bloom.
spell.grandsigil.full_bloom.guide: A circle of light opens in the ground and vines of light burst out of it, twisting together into a stem forty-six blocks tall. Leaves unfurl off it, and at the top a bud opens into a flower of light, twenty-two petals in three rings. For nine seconds it sheds pollen in a vast slow vortex out to fifty blocks: everything hostile beneath it is poisoned, slowed and worn down, with a wave of pollen rolling out every two seconds, while you and your allies are healed. Then its heart bursts, and the petals come away one by one and drift off as the stem unravels into light.

ui.grandsigil.ice_age.chill: Hostiles are chilled: %1$s per second, slowed and frozen through

ui.grandsigil.ice_age.shatter: At absolute zero the field shatters: %1$s, %2$s%% more on anything frozen solid
advancement.grandsigil.ice_age.title: Ice Age
advancement.grandsigil.ice_age.descripti: Bring a blizzard down out of the aurora.
advancement.grandsigil.absolute_zero.des: Shatter ten or more with a single ice age.
spell.grandsigil.ice_age.guide: The sky goes still and an aurora unrolls across it. Out of the cold a blizzard comes down as one vortex seventy blocks tall, flaring at the top into a spiral of driven snow, and frost runs out over the ground to the edge of a field fifty-six blocks across. For nine seconds everything hostile inside it is chilled, slowed and frozen through, while spears of frost fall out of the storm and burst where they land. Then the vortex draws in on itself, dragging everything it caught toward the middle, and at absolute zero the whole field shatters at once -- harder on whatever it managed to freeze solid.

ui.grandsigil.crimson_threads.drain: Drinks %1$s per second from each, %2$s%% harder for every other thread
ui.grandsigil.crimson_threads.heal: You are given %1$s%% of everything it drinks

advancement.grandsigil.crimson_threads.d: Raise a heart of blood and feed it.
advancement.grandsigil.bled_dry.title: Bled Dry
advancement.grandsigil.bled_dry.descript: Drink ten or more dry with a single heart.
spell.grandsigil.crimson_threads.guide: Blood wells up out of the ground round you in streams and gathers twenty-six blocks overhead into a heart, beating. It puts a thread into everything hostile within forty blocks, and for eight seconds it drinks on every beat -- harder the more it has bound -- while a stream of what it drinks pours down into you. At the end every thread snaps, tearing out of what it was in, and the heart comes down and is taken into you: a shield of health, strength, and the blood pushing everything near you away.

ui.grandsigil.dimension_cut.tear: The tear stays open %1$s seconds, pulling things in: %2$s per second in its mouth

death.attack.dimension_cut.player: %1$s was cut along with the space they stood in by %2$s
advancement.grandsigil.world_cleaver.des: Cut down ten or more with a single stroke.
spell.grandsigil.dimension_cut.guide: Space goes still and a hairline of light traces itself across where you are looking, ninety blocks long, slanting down into the ground. Then it is cut: a stroke of white light runs the length of it faster than the eye, finer cuts flash round it, and everything on the line is cleaved through whatever it is wearing. The cut opens into a tear in the world, black and full of stars, its lips burning violet, and for three seconds it drags everything near it back onto the line. Then it snaps shut, and the snap is a second cut.
